The '''Mayagil system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Mayagil sector/Legends|Mayagil sector]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mayagil system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-18.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
